```{r}
# load the image
load(paste0("processed_data/aggregating.rda"))
qc_dt <- fread("processed_data/qc_summary.csv")
qc_cols <- c(
  "fraction_mapped",
  "fraction_intergenic",
  "fraction_rrna",
  "fraction_duplicates"
)
gene_quants <- readRDS(paste0("suppa_analysis/gene_expressions_filtered.rds"))
download_metadata <- fread("processed_data/file_table.csv.gz")
fig1_color_dt <- unique(metadata[, .(get(ontology_column), harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1_color)])
color_mapping <- setNames(fig1_color_dt$harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1_color, fig1_color_dt[[ontology_column]])
color_mapping_hex <- sapply(strsplit(color_mapping, ","), function(x) rgb(x[1], x[2], x[3], maxColorValue = 255))
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
library(patchwork)
metadata_order <-
  melt(
    metadata,
    id.vars = c(
      "EpiRR_ordering",
      "epirr_id_without_version",
      ontology_column
    ),
    measure.vars = c(
      "automated_experiments_RNA-Seq_mRNA-Seq",
      "automated_experiments_RNA-Seq_total-RNA-Seq"
    ),
    variable.name = "experiment_type",
    value.name = "uuid"
  )[uuid != ""][order(EpiRR_ordering, uuid)]
metadata_order[, experiment_type := tstrsplit(experiment_type, "_", keep = 4)]
gene_mat <- as.matrix(dcast(gene_quants[gene_id %in% event_dt[, gene_id]], uuid ~ gene_id),
  rownames = "uuid"
)[metadata_order[, uuid], ]
gene_pca <- rsvd::rpca(gene_mat, 3)
rsvd::ggscreeplot(gene_pca)
variance <- gene_pca$sdev^2
explained_variance_ratio <- round(variance / gene_pca$var, 3) * 100
plot_dt <- as.data.table(gene_pca$x, keep.rownames = "uuid")
setnames(plot_dt, c("V1", "V2"), c("PC1", "PC2"))
plot_dt[download_metadata[assay_type == "RNA-Seq"],
  on = .NATURAL, c("experiment_type", "epirr_id_without_version") := .(experiment_type, epirr_id_without_version)
]
plot_dt[qc_dt, on = .NATURAL, (qc_cols) := mget(qc_cols)]
plot_dt <- merge(plot_dt, metadata)
setorder(plot_dt, EpiRR_ordering, uuid)
stopifnot(rownames(gene_pca$x) == plot_dt$uuid)
Reduce(`+`, lapply(qc_cols, function(color_col) {
  ggplot(plot_dt, aes(
    x = PC1,
    y = PC2,
    color = get(color_col)
  )) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(
      title = "PCA of gene expression data",
      x = paste("PC1 (", explained_variance_ratio[1], "% explained var.)", sep = ""),
      y = paste("PC2 (", explained_variance_ratio[2], "% explained var.)", sep = ""),
      color = color_col
    )
}))

onto_plot <- rsvd::ggindplot(gene_pca, groups = plot_dt[, factor(get(ontology_column), levels = unique(get(ontology_column)))], ind_labels = FALSE, alpha.ellipse = 0) + scale_color_manual(values = color_mapping_hex)
onto_plot[["guides"]][["colour"]] <- NULL
(rsvd::ggindplot(gene_pca, groups = plot_dt[, experiment_type], ind_labels = FALSE) + rsvd::ggindplot(gene_pca, pcs = c(1, 3), groups = plot_dt[, experiment_type], ind_labels = FALSE) + plot_layout(guides = "collect")) / onto_plot
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
library(seriation)
this_event <- "RI"
this_filter <- keep_rows
this_method <- "suppa"
# TODO: would be nice to have the event_dt in a format in which method is a column instead of a prefix of the sample columns

# Now do this first on RI and then on SE events
for (this_event in to_analyze) {
  # and with and without the filtered events
  curr_dt <- event_dt[`Event Type` == this_event]
  for (this_filter in list( # curr_dt[, ID],
    keep_rows
  )) {
    # filter the data
    filtered_dt <- curr_dt[ID %in% this_filter]
    for (this_method in c("suppa", "rmats")) {
      this_title <- paste(
        this_event,
        this_method,
        ifelse(identical(this_filter, keep_rows), "filtered", "all")
      )
      message(this_title)
      this_sample_cols <-
        names(event_dt)[startsWith(names(event_dt), this_method)]
      long_dt <- melt(
        filtered_dt,
        id.vars = "ID",
        measure.vars = this_sample_cols,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
      # remove the this_method prefix from the variable column
      long_dt[, variable := sub(paste0("^", this_method, "_"), "", variable)]
      this_sample_cols <-
        sub(paste0("^", this_method, "_"), "", this_sample_cols)
      long_dt[metadata_order, on = c(variable = "uuid"), experiment_type := i.experiment_type]

      # compute distances between events using wasserstein distance in 1D
      # make all possible combinations of the event IDs:
      distance_combs <-
        as.data.table(t(combn(filtered_dt[, ID], 2)))
      # normalized_hist_bins <- pbmclapply(long_dt[, ID], function(x) hist(long_dt[ID == x, value], breaks = seq(0, 1, by = binwidth_psi), plot = FALSE)[["density"]])
      # names(normalized_hist_bins) <- long_dt[, ID]

      distance_combs$distance <-
        pbmcmapply(
          distance_combs$V1,
          distance_combs$V2,
          FUN = function(x, y) {
            transport::wasserstein1d(
              long_dt[x == ID, value], # normalized_hist_bins[[x]], normalized_hist_bins[[y]])
              long_dt[y == ID, value]
            )
          }
        )

      event_dist_obj <-
        as.dist(as.matrix(dcast(
          rbind(distance_combs, setnames(
            copy(distance_combs),
            old = c("V1", "V2"),
            new = c("V2", "V1")
          )), V1 ~ V2,
          value.var = "distance"
        ), rownames = "V1"))
      if (any(is.na(event_dist_obj)) |
        any(is.infinite(event_dist_obj))) {
        warning(
          "There are missing or infinite values in the distance matrix. Please check the data."
        )
      }

      event_mat <-
        as.matrix(dcast(
          long_dt,
          variable ~ ID
        ), rownames = TRUE)[metadata_order[uuid %in% this_sample_cols, uuid], ]

      event_sds_mod <- apply(event_mat, 2, function(x) {
        x_non_na <- x[!is.na(x)]
        sqrt(sum((x_non_na - mean(x_non_na))^2) / (length(x) - 1))
      })
      event_sds <- apply(event_mat, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
      n_na <- apply(event_mat, 2, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
      cor(cbind(n_na, event_sds, event_sds_mod), method = "pearson")
      cor(cbind(n_na, event_sds, event_sds_mod), method = "spearman")

      dist_matrix <- dist(event_sds_mod, method = "euclidean")
      event_var_clust <- seriation:::reorder.hclust(
        hclust(dist_matrix, method = "ward.D2"),
        dist = dist_matrix,
        method = "OLO"
      )

      event_clust <-
        seriation:::reorder.hclust(
          hclust(event_dist_obj, method = "complete"),
          dist = event_dist_obj,
          method = "OLO"
        )

      row_anno <-
        as.data.frame(metadata_order[uuid %in% rownames(event_mat), .(
          epirr_id_without_version,
          annotation = get(ontology_column),
          experiment_type,
          uuid
        )])
      rownames(row_anno) <- row_anno$uuid
      row_anno$uuid <- NULL
      clust_list <- list(
        variability = event_var_clust,
        distribution = event_clust
      )
      for (i in names(clust_list)) {
        col_clust <- clust_list[[i]]
        pheatmap::pheatmap(
          main = paste(this_title, i),
          event_mat,
          cluster_cols = col_clust,
          cutree_cols = 3,
          cutree_rows = 2,
          show_colnames = FALSE,
          clustering_method = "ward.D2",
          show_rownames = FALSE,
          annotation_row = row_anno,
          na_col = "white"
        )
      }

      # mean impute per experiment_type for PCA
      for (subset in split(metadata_order[uuid %in% this_sample_cols], by = "experiment_type")) {
        uuid_subset <- subset[, uuid]
        for (i in seq_len(ncol(event_mat))) {
          event_mat[(rownames(event_mat) %in% uuid_subset) &
            is.na(event_mat[, i]), i] <-
            mean(event_mat[uuid_subset, i], na.rm = TRUE)
        }
      }

      event_pca <- rsvd::rpca(event_mat, 3)
      rsvd::ggscreeplot(event_pca)
      variance <- event_pca$sdev^2
      explained_variance_ratio <-
        round(variance / event_pca$var, 3) * 100
      plot_dt <- as.data.table(event_pca$x, keep.rownames = "uuid")
      setnames(plot_dt, c("V1", "V2"), c("PC1", "PC2"))
      plot_dt[download_metadata[assay_type == "RNA-Seq"], on = .NATURAL, c("experiment_type", "epirr_id_without_version") := .(experiment_type, epirr_id_without_version)]
      plot_dt[qc_dt, on = .NATURAL, (qc_cols) := mget(qc_cols)]
      plot_dt <- merge(plot_dt, metadata)
      setorder(plot_dt, EpiRR_ordering, uuid)
      stopifnot(rownames(event_pca$x) == plot_dt$uuid)
      title_string <-
        paste(
          "PCA of",
          this_event,
          "events; filtered",
          identical(this_filter, keep_rows),
          "; ",
          this_method
        )
      print(Reduce(`+`, lapply(qc_cols, function(color_col) {
        ggplot(plot_dt, aes(
          x = PC1,
          y = PC2,
          color = get(color_col)
        )) +
          geom_point() +
          labs(
            title = "PCA of gene expression data",
            x = paste(
              "PC1 (",
              explained_variance_ratio[1],
              "% explained var.)",
              sep = ""
            ),
            y = paste(
              "PC2 (",
              explained_variance_ratio[2],
              "% explained var.)",
              sep = ""
            ),
            color = color_col
          )
      })))
      onto_plot <-
        rsvd::ggindplot(
          event_pca,
          groups = plot_dt[, factor(get(ontology_column),
            levels = unique(get(ontology_column))
          )],
          ind_labels = FALSE,
          alpha.ellipse = 0
        ) + scale_color_manual(values = color_mapping_hex)
      onto_plot[["guides"]][["colour"]] <- NULL
      print((
        rsvd::ggindplot(event_pca, groups = plot_dt[, experiment_type], ind_labels = FALSE) + rsvd::ggindplot(
          event_pca,
          pcs = c(1, 3),
          groups = plot_dt[, experiment_type],
          ind_labels = FALSE
        ) + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
      ) / onto_plot)
    }
  }
}
```

# TODO variability or clustering:

```{r, compute-variability, eval=FALSE}
for (this_event in to_analyze) {
  # and with and without the filtered events
  curr_dt <- event_dt[`Event Type` == this_event]
  for (this_filter in list(curr_dt[, ID], keep_rows)) {
    # filter the data
    filtered_dt <- curr_dt[ID %in% this_filter]
    event_mat <- as.matrix(dcast(melt(filtered_dt, id.vars = "ID", measure.vars = sample_cols, na.rm = TRUE), variable ~ ID),
      rownames = TRUE
    )[metadata_order[uuid %in% sample_cols, uuid], ]
    metadata_order[experiment_type == "mRNA-Seq", .N]
    table(colSums(is.na(event_mat[metadata_order[, experiment_type == "mRNA-Seq"], ])))
    metadata_order[experiment_type == "total-RNA-Seq", .N]
    table(colSums(is.na(event_mat[metadata_order[, experiment_type == "total-RNA-Seq"], ])))
    # impute all NA's by colmean
    for (i in seq_len(ncol(event_mat))) {
      event_mat[is.na(event_mat[, i]), i] <- mean(event_mat[, i], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    # use seriation::reorder to cluster the rows and columns
    row_dist <- dist(event_mat)
    row_ser <- seriation::seriate(row_dist, method = "OLO")

    pheatmap::pheatmap(event_mat,
      clustering_method = "ward.D2",
      main = paste(this_event, ifelse(identical(this_filter, curr_dt[, ID]), "all", "filtered"), sep = " - "),
      annotation_col = as.data.frame(metadata_order[, c("experiment_type", ontology_column), with = FALSE], row.names = metadata_order[, uuid])
    )
  }
}

# compute Adj SD per event
event_dt[, `Adjusted PSI SD` := sqrt(rowSums((.SD - rowMeans(.SD, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE) / (length(sample_cols) - 1)), .SDcols = sample_cols]
# compute median Adj SD per event type on IDs in keep_rows
median_adj_sd <- event_dt[ID %in% keep_rows, .(med = median(`Adjusted PSI SD`, na.rm = TRUE), tmp_event_type = `Event Type`), by = `Event Type`][, `Event Type` := NULL]
# assign variability to each event
event_dt[ID %in% keep_rows, Variability := ifelse(`Adjusted PSI SD` >= median_adj_sd[`Event Type` == tmp_event_type, med], "High Variability", "Low Variability"), by = `Event Type`]
event_dt[ID %in% manual_ids, Variability := ifelse(`Adjusted PSI SD` >= median_adj_sd[`Event Type` == tmp_event_type, med], "High Variability", "Low Variability"), by = `Event Type`]
# make sure the order is correct
event_dt[, Variability := factor(Variability, levels = c("Low Variability", "High Variability"))]
```
